gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham opens with tall, rounded lowercase and c shapes that leave plenty of entry space. And Origami, a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness, is the bolder, more unusual voice beside it.
